correctness.rationale: The \(k\)-fold onset threshold follows from summing cap inequalities against the regular-simplex vertex sum and is attained by the normalized sum. For \(n\ge5\), the onset rescaling has nonnegative density exponent and converges by dominated convergence to a beta integral. The \(n=4\) asymptotic is not claimed.
